title: Vampire Vape Sweet Tobacco Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Vampire Vape’s Sweet Tobacco is a perfectly balanced blend of rich, earthy, smoky tobacco tempered by a beguiling layer of sweet, soothing caramel for a vape that is smooth and mellow and incredibly satisfying. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend offers the perfect balance between flavour and cloud production and the nicotine salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter vape kits and pod vape devices. Perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts with a super-smooth throat hit.
